text:
Jenna (Design): Quick sync on the new token flows. Seeing a few recurring UX questions from the usability sessions: how we surface expiry defaults, copy for the one-time secret reveal, and the revoke confirmation affordances. Sharing updated artboard: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/tokens-v2 (see modal + list + empty state).

Ava (PM): TL;DR goals: reduce accidental admin token creation, make ephemeral copy obvious, and make revoke reversible for 10s. Also want metrics for copy and revoke events.

Luis (Eng): From infra side, we can return an extra response flag when a token has admin scopes: `x-token-admin: true`. Use it client-side to show the stronger nudge.

Maya (Security): Prefer inline nudge over modal blockers. Example text: "Admin scopes allow full project access — prefer scoped tokens where possible." Also require an explicit dropdown selection for org-wide tokens (not just a checkbox).

Kevin (Frontend): A11y + DOM order note: the show-secret control needs to be right after the token value heading so keyboard users can discover it before the copy button. For the initial reveal, focus should go to the token text and its container should have `role=region aria-live=polite` so screen readers get the message.

Sam (A11y): We'll need an SR-only hint: "This value is shown only once. Use Copy to save it now." Also assert the reveal doesn't cause focus loss. For the revoke snackbar, use `aria-live=assertive` and ensure it doesn't steal focus but is reachable by keyboard.

Noor (QA): I ran small user tests yesterday. Many users expected "Rotate" to show the new secret inline like Create does. We should keep behavior consistent: Rotate opens a modal that reveals the secret immediately with the same affordances as Create. Add end-to-end tests for rotate copy timing.

Jenna (Design): Empty state copy suggestion: Heading: "No API tokens yet". Body: "Create a token to use the Redwood API. Tokens are shown once; copy them now." Primary CTA label: "Create token". Secondary: "Learn about scopes" link. Leave the CTA prominent and centered.

Ava (PM): Good. Also add a microcopy near expiry: "Expires in (default 90 days for org, 30 for personal)". Make defaults visible but editable.

Maya (Security): While we're at it, let's add a tiny audit checkbox: "Log token usage to org audit trail" (checked by default for org tokens). This helps compliance teams.

Luis (Eng): Implementation detail: backend will emit `event=token.created` and include `scope_summary` in analytics payload. We'll also add `token.visibility=one-time` if the secret is returned once.

Kevin (Frontend): Visual contrast finds: the warning badge we use next to admin scopes is 3:1 but icon stroke is thin and looks faint on hover. I'll thicken the stroke and test dark mode. Also we'll add a small shield icon on high-privilege chips so color isn't the only indicator.

Sam (A11y): Keyboard flow checklist to enforce: open modal -> Name (input) -> Scopes (combobox) -> Expiry (select) -> Show secret (checkbox/toggle) -> Reveal (button) -> Token value (focusable region) -> Copy -> Create. If any element is conditionally visible, ensure it receives focus when inserted.

Noor (QA): I'll write tests for VoiceOver and NVDA for the entire path including rotate and revoke undo. Also add timing tests for the undo snackbar (10s).

Ava (PM): On revoke: plan is immediate soft-revoke with undo. If undo is expired, backend will hard-revoke. For org tokens require a typed confirmation for high-impact tokens: user types token name to confirm.

Maya (Security): +1 for typed confirm on org tokens. Also require the revoke dialog include the list of recent services that used the token (if available) so users understand impact.

Jenna (Design): I'll update Figma with: 1) explicit expiry microcopy, 2) show/announce pattern for the one-time secret, 3) warning styles + shield icon, 4) revoke typed-confirm pattern for org tokens, and 5) empty state layout. Will add component-level notes about focus management.

Luis (Eng): Once Jenna updates, ping me. I'll wire the `x-token-admin` header and `token.visibility` flag, and add the events: `token.create`, `token.copy`, `token.revoke`, `token.rotate` with properties: scope_summary, expiry_days, visibility.

Kevin (Frontend): I'll prototype the reveal + copy interactions in storybook and include keyboard tests. Link PR when ready.

Noor (QA): ops-bot created a preview build: https://preview.redwood.ai/pr/290/tokens-v2 . I'll run the QA checklist there tomorrow.

Ava (PM): Thanks team. Jenna, aim to land Figma updates today. I'll open two tickets: UX follow-ups and Analytics/Backend.

Jenna (Design): Will do. Dropping a few inline comments on the Figma for the revoke modal and the empty state copy. :sparkles:
